en.title: Fix WebGL2 mip sampling, nested hit targets and the model gallery
en.body: Multi-level pages use mipmap-capable minification. CSS hit targets account for transformed parents. The example server serves the registered gallery models. The Lanterns check measures the additional light cast when the shrine is reached.

zh.title: 修复 Windows WebGL2 多级纹理、嵌套命中区和模型画廊入口
zh.body: 多级纹理使用支持 mipmap 的缩小滤波。点击区域计入父级变换。示例服务器可访问画廊及其已注册模型。灯笼示例按抵达神龛后新增的亮区验收。
